sections.label: Secondary 1 places for PSLE students
sections.summary: MOE plans enough Secondary 1 places for all PSLE students in that cohort.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) plans for sufficient Secondary 1 places to cater to all Primary School Leaving Examination (PSLE) students in that cohort.

sections.label: 2024 Secondary 1 Posting Exercise outcomes
sections.summary: Over 90% of the cohort got one of their six choices, others went to the nearest school with vacancies, comparable to the previous three years.

sentences.text: Under the 2024 Secondary 1 Posting Exercise, more than 90% of the cohort were placed in schools among their six choices.
For the remaining students, they were posted to the school nearest to their residences that had vacancies in their eligible posting groups.
Overall, the posting outcome was comparable to the previous three years.

sections.label: COP as historical data
sections.summary: The COP is historical data based on the previous year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: The second point in terms of the COP, COP is actually historical data, based on the previous year.

sections.label: Appeals numbers and percentages
sections.summary: Direct appeal numbers are unavailable, but appeal percentages are very low and consistent over the last couple of years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: For the third part, the Member had questions about appeals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: We do not have the direct numbers of appeals, but appeals percentages are very low and it is consistent over the last couple of years.

sections.label: Assigning nearest school with vacancy
sections.summary: MOE is committed to assigning a school that is closest, with vacancy, within the vicinity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: With regard to the distances, for example, MOE is committed to assigning a school that is closest, with vacancy, within the vicinity.
